patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content blocks and two-column layouts, often pairing text with a large image or graphic.
Headings are set in a very large, bold sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible body text and occasional uppercase labels.
A high-contrast dark theme uses a near-black background with white text, punctuated by vibrant, gradient-based accent colors for graphics and calls to action.
The hero background dynamically transforms from a subtle static pattern to an intricate, animated canvas graphic as the user scrolls down the page.
The global navigation bar remains sticky at the top, visually transforming by gaining a solid dark background and subtle resizing after the initial scroll.
The site uses a full-width, gradient-filled call-to-action section ('Ready to light it up?') as a prominent visual break before the footer.

technique_notes: The hero section features a dynamic background that transforms from a static image to an interactive, animated canvas graphic as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and engagement, likely orchestrated with GSAP ScrollTrigger.

The global navigation bar is sticky and undergoes a visual transformation (gaining a solid background and subtle resizing) after the user scrolls past the initial hero content, using CSS transitions or GSAP.
Content sections are likely revealed with subtle animations, such as fade-ins or slide-ups, as they enter the viewport, orchestrated by a scroll-triggered animation library like GSAP.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean body text and even smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp for most elements, subtle rounding on buttons and interactive components.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero and between major sections, with balanced padding within content blocks.

standout: This site stands out with its sophisticated integration of scientific and tech-inspired visuals, particularly the dynamic, animated canvas background in the hero that transforms on scroll. The use of vibrant, almost neon-like gradients against a deep dark background creates a distinctive and modern aesthetic that feels both cutting-edge and luxurious.
